post.title: Mortgage rates stopped climbing. At 7.4%
post.ig:
Mortgage rates finally stopped climbing, at 7.4%.
Freddie Mac's 30-year fixed average held at 7.40% on Oct 15, 2026, ending seven straight weekly increases and tied for the highest since November 2023.
A year ago it was 6.27%. The 2026 low was 5.98% in February.
Example: on a $300,000, 30-year loan, principal and interest go from about $1,795 a month at 5.98% to about $2,077 at 7.40%, roughly $282 more.
Sources: Freddie Mac Primary Mortgage Market Survey, Oct 15, 2026 and archive.
